Is it not essential for the people of India and all the cultural center trainers who try to impart this to think whether they want to raise their children like this? Do not try to make yourselves incompetent! I offer this before you with the request that you give importance to my repeated pleas.

I see that even those who have cooperated with me in daily life for twenty or thirty years still have minor doubts and find themselves in the unfortunate position of being unable to explain this matter to another person. However, among Hindus—from temple dwellers to Shudras—we have a medium adopted to understand God. Using that as a medium, an advertisement was placed in two newspapers at a cost, along with an astrologer's planetary chart. It was explicitly stated in the astrological query (*Prashnaroodha*) itself that this has not been attained by the lineage of Acharyas until today, that liberation is being granted as requested by the deities, and that the impurity of that very astrologer's family temple has been removed. Once again, those belonging to the temple dwellers and temple believers have sent me several letters in a way that shows they have understood nothing. Who knows what they understood about that astrological query! In that advertisement itself, it was specifically written that they should come to the ashram to find out. Instead, they wrote letters. And the others did not understand anything either. It is with all this in mind that I have written such a message. I wish for you to read and understand this patiently.
May this auspicious day bring goodness to you.
Yours, Swami
Guruvani
September 1987

You people of Palakkad do not have a small life. You have a certain dignity. Even today, you are truly dignified. Why is that? Because they work hard and live off their earnings without harming anyone else. Such a large community exists in this region. However, minor ignorances have occurred. That happens, aren't we humans? Except for what has come from holding the flags of today's politics or imitating various other things, you are worthy - more than anyone elseٹ . You possess honesty. These ruined Namboothiris - though they are useless in some aspects, they are good in others. The entire land currently in the hands of the Shudra class was once theirs. Even today, if one of them is called up in a case and asked, they will not lie. If asked why this is not yours, they will simply say that the possession rights belong to the others. But if it were our people, they would try to lie a little. Despite having such honesty, they were ruined. Why did they lose their Vedic and administrative authority? At the same time, despite being very low religiously, the Shudra has come to the forefront. Even after all this, why doesn't your self-awareness emerge?

It is not just the glory of the era. We don't get that understanding. We only get what our parents showed us. Isn't it through them that our life itself moves forward? Did we have Vedic authority or scholarly expertise? Then how did we come forward? Be it through some imitation or anything else, when we get it, do we have the sense to stubbornly develop it? How many great souls were born here for us? The Parayi Petta Panthirukulam, the eighteen Siddhars - they were born among these Dravidians. Buddha explained what this is for, and told us to do so-and-so. We couldn't take up a path that was told to us like this for ourselves - even today we can't! Recently in Kerala itself, Sankaracharya, Sree Narayana Guru, and Chattampi Swami came. What have we done? Haven't we divided ourselves in the name of caste, confined it within the caste, put it inside a fence, and poured water? Then what is the meaning of saying we didn't get it? Whatever we get, we must grab it quickly. Isn't this because we lack the stubbornness and zeal to have it?

Despite having administrative and Vedic authority, how did they lose it? It was not discarded by simply stating it was unwanted, was it? You yourselves are aware that there were eighteen *Agraharams* (Brahmin settlements) here. Why do you not consider how these were lost? The fourth quarter is the era of the Shudras. It is not their era. Why are we unable to claim it? We are standing in a lineage where our tradition has ruined us. That is the reason. For example, when mentioning the Palakkad region, you yourselves are aware. You know that there is a practice of consecrating and worshipping (*Vacharadhana*), do you not? We handle this in various ways. Is there not a system in our land of consecrating and worshipping even *Karinkuttichathan*? If this *Karinkuttichathan* becomes our deity, who will we become? Suppose a sorcerer in our family consecrated this; where will this sorcerer stand when he dies? If this ancestor goes astray, who will we, born in that lineage (*Rashi*), become? Then, is there any doubt that our deity and our object of worship—all these aforementioned things—have led us astray? An example of this is that all these Brahmins have reached their current state today. We never performed more than them, did we! We only did trivial things using all this. At the same time, they would step out of the house only after strictly following the procedures using this. What has become of them today? Some may say it is because they performed it incorrectly. Did everyone perform it incorrectly?

What you call imitation is indeed correct. If it were not for this attire and language of the British today, would we have been able to obtain even a single penny from the government? So, we have no attire, no language; are we merely the ones who came to claim ownership of the attire and language of those who belonged to a wretched system? Despite facing such a predicament, why can we not change away from it?
Guruvani
October 1987

I shall recount an experience of mine to you.* There is a difficulty in deceiving you by telling this. That is why I am speaking to you in this manner. If told in any other way, you will not be able to accept it. Several people have come to me. There are a few who have known me since childhood. I was a believer in God. I only knew that. I knew nothing else.

I lived at home until the age of ten or fourteen. I had to commit a deception to leave home. I also knew that it was the only way to leave home. Is there not a custom among us to go to Palani? Stating that a garland and a vow were required for it, I wore them. Thus, I left under the pretext of going to Palani. I went straight to the ashrams. I engaged in various positions within the ashrams. I found no satisfaction from any of this.

My entire desire was to attain a spiritual realization (*Anubhuthi*). It is the Sri Ramakrishna Mission and the Sri Narayana Mission that stand strengthened in Kerala today. I am well-acquainted with both of these. Then there are the lineages of Madhva and Sri Shankara—they do not prove to be of much use to the Shudra class in that manner. Because caste and such are still deeply entrenched there. Therefore, there is no salvation there. Near the very house where I was born, there is an ashram belonging to the Sri Ramakrishna Mission. I was associated with it as well. Apart from that, I spent seventeen years associated with the Sri Narayana Mission and its other temples. Not only was I associated, but I also handled several matters within its administration.

They had arranged the rituals of worship and all other regulations. Whatever this may be, to speak of a realization from this—there was a realization lasting two days. Other than that, there was nothing. Thus, with the desire for a Guru, if I learned that an individual resided anywhere, I would leave the ashram citing some excuse. I would go and observe there. In this manner, I regularly visited a person who sat like an *Avadhuta* for ten years, going there one day a month. I would go stating that I needed to visit one of the ashram's branches. I would go there just for the namesake. Then, during the night, I would sit with this person the whole time. This person lay on the sand at the beach. Despite going for ten years, I gained nothing from this person. It was not because he did not know how to speak; rather, he simply did not speak.

While things were thus, I found a monk through another person. He understood me as soon as I arrived. Yet, he said nothing. He said, "Let it be tomorrow." When I went the next day, he asked, "You are the person who came yesterday, aren't you?" This man also lay on the sand and in the bushes. "Why have you come?" he asked me. I replied in a single word. Saying, "You are the rightful inheritor," he embraced me and wept. He wrote down a mantra for me and said, "You must keep using this. Then realization will occur. You must come here when that happens."

The experience came. I went. Everything is there. But it will take a very long time. I understood nothing. Even after two and a half years, there was no result. Meanwhile, difficulties, hardships, and tribulations were pouring in. I never did anything to warrant that. After this, whatever the experience was, it remained unclear. Aside from it being proven true, I do not know what it is like or how it is.
You will only understand if it is stated as it is. If said in any other way, it will not be clear to you. Therefore, I only recounted my experience. You should pay attention to at least that.

He himself had a desire to grant me a realization somehow. He would say it whenever we met. One day, a situation arose where I had to leave Sivagiri itself. I had not committed any mistake to warrant that either.

Before that, he had shared a word with me. While wandering as an *Avadhuta*, he came there. One day, after the puja was completed, as I came out carrying the offering plate (*thattam*), a person acquainted with me came and said that a Swami was standing there inquiring about me. I immediately handed over the plate and went. He instantly said: "I am going on a journey from here. There is a change for you from here. You must not leave without seeing me."

To leave after saying this out of nowhere! I could not believe it. Because I had been rendering service for so long. And not by taking a single penny. I had been there for such a long time. How could I leave from there? Even if asked to leave, would I muster the courage to go?
Guruvani
November 1987

When left with no other choice*, I moved away, built a hut, and stayed there for seven years and four months. In the fourth month, on the first day of the *Vrischikam* month, seven people arrived. They came carrying all kinds of food items in their hands. They said, "We are observing a vow here today." Based on what they went and told others, eight to ten people arrived the next day. In this manner, within that month itself, the situation became such that nearly a hundred people were arriving daily. They claimed that their diseases and troubles would be cured. This was the knowledge gained from what they said. Furthermore, peace was also visible in all those who came. After continuing like this for about two and a half years, it ceased to yield results.

The spiritual experience occurred at the Thuckalay Munsiff Court. It took approximately three years to complete. All the demons associated with the completion of the Trimurti system—whatever names are spoken—they are all present. What we have heard of in this world is very little. What comes before us is in the crores. All these do indeed exist. But what spiritual strength will this impart to us? Apart from obtaining a result when offering certain vows and oblations, when one transforms into a human being with spiritual experiences, what realization is gained from it? For its spiritual peace. This became clear to me. It is said in the Gita itself—Dharma is that which is directly perceivable, is it not! Standing materialized and imparting knowledge, and having received guidance in such a manner, I became convinced that this is the truth. After becoming convinced, the question arose as to how to manage this. When it was managed, it was completely fruitful. Not a single syllable failed to bear fruit. This was effective for hundreds of people. It was not managed by me alone. Regarding the ailments, those that were given up by the Medical College came and were completely cured. Even bladder cancer was cured. If this is spoken of, people will naturally come! Following this, it became ineffective. People suddenly began to hurl abuses. There was no information as to what it was. Investigations were made through all possible means of inquiry. It did not become clear. At that time, a word was received. The two lines currently chanted, "Om Sri Karunakaraguru Parabrahmanane Namaha / Om Sri Karunakaraguru Satyapradaya Namaha" were stated, and it was said: "You must chant this and strengthen yourself. Otherwise, harm will befall you." It was not understood. My name comes within this. Because the name appeared, I told the children who received it not to chant it. Since they had received it through revelation, they would chant it without my knowledge—without making a sound.

After three years, there was a relocation from this place to another place—the place currently occupied. It was only after being told three times not to stay here that the move there occurred. It was instructed that one should not reside there in a manner visible to two people. Today, there is nothing there. It has simply become barren land. It lies like a withered, grass-covered expanse on the sloped area of the hill.

A few days after arriving here, a large number of people started coming. Normally, such gatherings do not occur at Hindu places of worship. But this was indeed a massive crowd. People just began arriving in that manner. Suddenly, it reverted to the old state. The reason for this was unknown. What was instructed had not been violated. It was said that an error had occurred. If an error had occurred, why could it not be pointed out? The number of people who arrived was overwhelmingly large. If necessary, it was enough to cause harm to the Ashram itself. There were prominent merchants. There were those who came from high social standings.

They were residing on this rocky ground, enduring the dew, rain, sun, and wind. It was for their ailments to be cured. There were no other buildings anywhere here. There was something akin to a small marquee. How many could sleep inside it? Yet, all of them kept coming like this. However, they had faith in me—in this work of mine. Regardless, I told them one thing: I will only come out after understanding this. You must take care of these patients. There were mentally ill individuals, those with stomach pain, and those with various types of diseases. Having said this, I went inside and sat down. All these patients became violently agitated. Those with stomach pain started screaming terribly. The mentally ill, since there were no trees here, went to climb and hang themselves on the trees in the adjacent property. In this manner, some fifty or sixty individuals became agitated in this state. Those who ran away were chased down and brought back.

That evening at five o'clock, an announcement was made that food should not be consumed. It was said that even water should not be drunk. There were two merchants. Saying, "Now water cannot be drunk, such a rule has come," they went to the well, drew water, and drank it. Five minutes later, they vomited. What they vomited was poison—like something mixed with green color being poured out. Swelling also developed. When two others went outside, they received two blows—from where, it was unknown. Terrified, everyone remained inside. This was the incident of that day.

That evening, permission was given to consume food. The announcement came: "I will come when it is five minutes to six o'clock. You must all be ready for prayer." It was done accordingly. On that very day, three patients were instructed to act in a specific manner. They were cured. Thus, within fifteen days, all these ailments were completely cured.

Then, a journey was instructed. Among the journeys undertaken in that manner, one proceeded up to Chidambaram, the largest temple in South India, but it was not continued thereafter. Walking continuously from Kanyakumari through this region, Chidambaram was reached. Even after arriving there, there was nothing to impart. It was decided, "I will not go anywhere anymore."
Guruvani
December 1987

There was an occasion of becoming bewildered after receiving visions. An astrological consultation was conducted to find out why such bewilderment was occurring, and it was found that while standing under the deity, only that much could be done. A visit was made to the astrologer, along with Parameswaran Pillai. There was a belief that some particular state of affairs had taken hold, and that it would change.

The visit to the astrologer was made yielding to compulsion. The astrologer cast one or two zodiacal signs. The Bhrigu Samhita is used to ascertain the astrological calculations based on the zodiac. The Bhrigu Samhita is recorded in the form of a dialogue between a Guru and a disciple. According to it, what was seen was that he is a celibate, a perfect individual. A mistake caused by a woman in some past life is what is reflecting now.

The experience was also the same—because of this woman, there were constant quarrels and commotions. It was believed that this was indeed true. The Bhrigu Samhita was not read completely. Only an approximation had been read. Therefore, the remaining part could not be understood. It stated in it that nothing should be done for two years. For these two and a half years, nothing was done. After that, it was impossible to stay there. It became necessary to leave that place.

It was from there that the residence at Santhigiri in Pothencode began. Nine months after coming and residing there, this became clear again. Instruction was given to act. It was done. When it was done, bewilderment ensued. Even then, this woman was present. She would speak falsely through visions. She would tell lies in the manner of the most deceitful ascetic. How did this girl, who was only about nineteen or twenty years old, obtain this deceitful secret? There must be some deceit within her. Otherwise, there is no need for her to say this. I am a person who has travelled with an ascetic who had attained numerous avadhuta states. How did she acquire this falsehood that I cannot even conceive of? It could not be grasped. She was laying a snare and encircling. I distanced myself without falling into her trap, like iron and butter. I was very cautious.

That was the truth. It took another four years for that to become clear. All this time, she was also following behind. A falsehood that she was Madurai Meenakshi. The parents said that she had a disease associated with the worship of Madurai Meenakshi. It was with the plea to save her somehow that she was brought. But she had come to kill. Taking me along to her house in Chirayinkeezhu, she claimed that the heat of the homam performed there still remained. That the heat of a homam performed eight or ten generations ago still remained!

Upon reflection, what was revealed was a Brahmin woman. When trying to catch her, she would hide behind someone. She was the one who instructed to place the Rudraksha. When asked what kind of Rudraksha should be placed, she told us to ask the disciples. We asked. Then it was said that an old man and an old woman reside to the southeast of the Changanassery market, and that it could be obtained if we went there. We took the car and went. Approaching the Vazhappally temple, we saw a Vedic priest (*Vaidikavadhyar*). When asked, he said there was such a house. Without seeing him, this could not have been known. He showed the way. We proceeded accordingly, and after travelling a distance, the person who had the vision suddenly asked to stop the vehicle. The instruction regarding that woman was that a person with a dark mark on the tip of the nose could be seen, and if asked, he would know. When asked, he showed us the house. The first thing we saw there was many children living on rent. These people also lived in a room in that house (their own house). There was a very mature and virtuous mother (a Brahmin woman) there. The information obtained was that when her parents lived in Thanjavur, they used to worship using Rudrakshas. We checked again. Upon checking, it was found to be true.

That is the nature of a vision. It does not provide direct answers. It only gives convoluted words. Firstly, it observes the nature of the person having the vision. It primarily examines what kind of person he is and whom he obeys. Those who experience visions must understand this.

Upon reaching there, it was said that there is such a wise person and we could go there. Taking them in the car, the journey continued. We came back to the first person himself. Wouldn't that have been enough in the first place? It was not revealed. This person said that his father (the Vedic priest) had the job of dressing Lord Shiva in the attire of an ascetic on the day of Vaikathashtami. With the Temple Entry Proclamation, Shiva's asceticism all fell apart, didn't it! He said: "My father had plenty of Rudrakshas. Father took handfuls of them and gave them away to many people. Now a few remain. We can examine them."

He and his wife came along. An old Brahmin mansion (*Illam*). We examined the entire place. A six-faced Rudraksha was found. The rest had four and five faces. Those with four faces were more numerous. What we needed was a seven-faced one. It was being said that it would suffice to hold on to him for that. It would not be stated directly. There were four Brahmin mansions there. We went to all of them. There was nothing there. When asked again, it was indicated to persist with this person himself. We came back here again. Then he brought another twenty-five or so from there. Those too were six-faced. We checked again. Then it was said that there was a specially carved ceiling beam. It was hanging there. Could this not have been said earlier? This is what a vision is. It is that convoluted. It requires that much patience. A clue was found only after wandering and travelling like this for a whole day without even drinking water.

Then what they did was perform the *Kanyadaanam* (giving away of a maiden) of this priest's elder brother's daughter. Would the Shudras have the knowledge to do that? What have they done? They brought clothes, flowers, and fruits, seated her in the prayer room, had this maiden perform the *pooja*, and conducted the *Kanyadaanam*. It was the re-enactment of a very ancient bond. This girl was eleven years old at that time. Their calculations also turned out to be correct. The reasoning they provided was that if she crossed eleven years of age, this girl would come of age. Therefore, this ritual had to be performed immediately.
The Error in the Valuation of India

To establish the value of the India we know, one must necessarily explain the function of the *Manusmriti*. The functional capacity that is often referred to as *Sanatana* (eternal) has been lost to us; we do not know where and how it was lost. However, we know today that the originality was lost because of attempts to sustain a cultural lifestyle by interpolating various tales. Not many people are aware of this. It should not be blamed on anyone. However, the truth that it happened this way must be revealed. The multitudes seeking a solution for this cannot handle it without a framework of chronological determination. We must perceive our era, or India's era, as that of the world. One should not assume that accounts akin to the mere mention of *Ramarajya* are devoid of narrative substance. It is spoken with substance. According to the *Manusmriti*, various calculations are stated regarding the *Yuga Dharma*. Which among these is an adjustable calculation? The information obtained here is different.

There is a book by Dayananda Saraswati titled *Veda Paryatanam*. It discusses this to some extent. But even in that, an inability to articulate everything has occurred over the vast expanse of time. That too should not be seen as a fault. It must be endured. We must endure and deal with the plight—caused by the structural peculiarities of each nation and occurring globally—that cannot be measured and recorded by time, which has befallen every nation just as it has ours.

If we do not exhibit this tolerance, it will become impossible to explain the fluctuations of the epochs to the coming generation. This much serves as its preface. A few more details regarding this are added below. There are a few other matters to be written with their respective causes and effects. Since there is no time for that now, they will be communicated later.

The divine resolve (*Brahmanischaya*) and the *Yuga Dharma* within it progress through divine course. This is stated specifically upon observing the changes according to the transformations of the *Yuga Dharma*. That resolve would be in accordance with the command of the lineage of Manus. While this should have been for the propagation of Dharma, it turned into the propagation of logic due to the rational thinking and erudition of a guru in the Manu lineage. Due to the scholarly methods of worship adopted by the people in later times, a tragic situation arose where epochs could not be determined. Neither the scholar nor the rationalist knows that this is a predestined act. Who knows that such an error is 25 *Chaturyugas* old! In that context, although some eminent scholars speak of Manu, even they are uncertain about the duration of Manu's era. The reason for this is the opportunism of the scholar who scribbled into Hindu Dharma that one day of Brahma is the time span of 14 Manus. When aligned with that, it became impossible for man even to contemplate cause and effect. This opportunism spread and flourished, bringing forth the word *Rama*. When it was brought to the form of *Siddha*, the *Amarakosha* emerged. That later ascribed importance to the deity and culminated even in *Dasiyattam* (Devadasi dance). The error lies in man becoming entranced and falling for this art form. When such an art form entered the glory of mystical powers (*Siddhi*) and the application of medicinal values, it reached up to alchemy. Those compositions are the *Bhogar Pathiraayiram* and *Agasthyar Ezhayiram*. When valuation occurred in this manner, the *Siddhimarga* of sleight of hand manifested in the form of divine names. Those practices eventually evolved and diverged into many forms such as *Hatha Yoga*, *Chandrika Yoga*, *Hamsa Yoga*, and *Raja Yoga*, thereby creatively bringing about a tidal wave of miracles. It is not difficult for us to see that today if we observe closely.

Even the common man is well acquainted with those referred to as *Yogiswaran* or *Mantramoorthi*. In my own house, such forms of worship were maintained. I have a memory of it being said that meals were served on 101 banana leaves. Even those who speak of this 'serving' do not know all the names of those (deities).

In this manner, 25 *Chaturyugas* (epochs) have passed. How can this be realized within the goals of a human or a deity? What can an ascetic, yogi, or sage achieve when they reach a transformative state involving practices ranging from *Kuttichathan* to the even baser demonic act of *Odividya* (black magic)? This is particularly relevant when determining the eras that emerged through a path of service involving the transmutation of the nine poisonous minerals (*Navapashanas*) into a panacea, combined with miraculous medicinal administrations. Observe the rituals where spirits and yogis still manifest to bestow blessings, as well as the people who flock to witness them. This holds true in my experience as well. It continues to stand in the light of truth even today. Astonishing acts, demonstrating that even an individual who learns to handle the earth's *navaratnas* (nine gems) and *navapashanas* can do anything, are the cause of various natural disasters on earth, such as earthquakes. Practices like Hatha Yoga, Chandrika Yoga, Hamsa Yoga, and Raja Yoga are all profound, vibratory sleights of hand meant to master this. Everyone knows today that these materials are researched through advanced mining techniques and utilized extensively. However, an unseen danger lurks within this. If scientists lack such awareness, the only result will be banishment by kings. This is a perilous trap. Having acquired this level of skill and capability, consider the multitude of dangers we share here within a lifespan of a hundred or two hundred years—yours or mine!

America is the dwelling place of those who were exiled by the wisdom of kings (America—the place where the mother resides). It evolved through commerce and plunder, culminating in capitalist-labor conflicts, and is now hybridized with harmonious tunes akin to *Satyam Sivam Sundaram*. Consequently, utilizing the ingenuity of filmmakers, they manage to depict images such that one can view even the picture of the globe by looking into a large water bubble. Similarly, the application of gas has advanced to the use of cooking gas, leading us to a situation where we have rendered ourselves incapable of living without it.

When the *Bharadwaja Samhita* was composed, the guru stated that it would not be suitable for the specific times. Eventually, the ideological difference between the disciple and the guru culminated in the Rama-Ravana war. This is the summary of the *Bharadwaja Samhita*. However, how would the public know that this was merely a difference of opinion between a guru and a disciple? The *Bharadwaja Samhita* was subsequently taken from the eastern countries. Today, Western nations have become its proprietors. Along those lines, they even manufacture war materials and distribute them via fighter jets. While all this may seem beneficial to our contemporaries, it has evolved into a massive undertaking that violates the eternal dharma across epochs for future generations. Today, based on minor discoveries, they assert that dark clouds transform in the sky, becoming a barrier that prevents the light of the sun and the moon from reaching the earth. Briefly put, this is another peril sign, much like the *Chakara* (mud bank phenomenon) we observe in the sea. This has grown, and all nations have begun to handle it. Thus, all combustible gases become mutually supportive. We can only comprehend this through a minor incident today: a gas cylinder explodes, causing an accident. Who can dismantle this perilous trap that has extended even to mere kerosene? The aforementioned dark cloud sphere is forged from all these elements. What if it swells like a ball in the sky, eclipsing the sun, and either accelerates or decelerates the orbital paths of other celestial bodies! The *Navagrahas* (nine planets) are entities that roll within this space. If this sphere of dark clouds were to infiltrate the space among the *Navagrahas*, imagine the widespread destruction it would unleash. One such phenomenon is the comet you can visibly witness today. In scientific circles, it is stated that whichever countries it passes over suffer damage. We have learned that wars erupt in every country it traverses. We are essentially watching a performance without understanding the story. Today, it is a drama unfolding before us. That drama itself has morphed into various forms like *Chavittunadakam* and musical drama, eventually culminating in cinema. This is our historical truth.

I shall provide another illustration for this. During his invasions of India, Mahmud of Ghazni attacked the Somnath temple multiple times. His father, noticing his frustration at being unable to lift the idol, suggested a simple trick: to hold a piece of plank directly above the idol. Consequently, the idol fell to the ground. The consecrator had installed this magnetic field to create awe through an act of mechanical ingenuity. While the consecrator utilized this field as a clever device, the invader employed a different trick to plunder the *navaratnas*. After extracting the *navaratnas*, the idol was cast down as a stepping stone for the mosque. This represents an unscientifically evolved danger zone. Can anyone undo the violent pact made against our future generations by resorting to statecraft that constructs such an extensive danger zone? It would be prudent for scientists and ascetics to reflect upon this. For who does not know that all these discoveries are merely constructing fatal danger zones of this nature? This lethal junction is the legacy everyone is collectively preparing for the coming generation. It is the duty of the scientists making these discoveries to document their inherent dangers. The rationalism and theories of liberation that so-called writers here document for the welfare of humanity are not only futile but also constitute the greatest tragedy. Certain regions will sink as a result of this catastrophe. The clusters of the Himalayan mountain ranges, as well as the mountain ranges stretching all the way to Kanyakumari in India, are the result of such a geological upheaval that occurred on earth. Similar formations exist in every country. Therefore, scientists must prove the identity of these gases that are experienced as snow-capped mountains, cold, and heat. If they so desire, this is an era in which they are capable of proving it.

Just like the art enthusiasts who write stories and novels—donning disguises by writing erotic tales, trapping innocent children in a shower of illusions and inciting them to bear double burdens, and creating rationalism and theories of liberation capable of keeping them tethered to the excitement of forging pathless paths—there also exist eloquent songs, an asceticism that does not employ even a shred of cloth, and theatrical performances that exaggerate this grotesquely. Writers who entertain through comforting prose and the theater artists have collectively transmitted everything from *Odividya* to *Chakyar Koothu*, *Ottamthullal*, and *Kathakali*. This is the contemporary *Shudra* guise. Are those called scientists, who create the play and rhythm that produce melodious sequences, any better than the knowledge that delights in the pyrotechnic display known as the grand finale? Reflect upon this! Oh scientists, oh writers who craft works of art, do not destroy children by pouring down a shower of illusions upon them....

Reflect also on the veil of ignorance that does not hesitate to claim, through relentless writing, "I too am a researcher!" May discovery impart goodness to humanity. The path of truth and falsehood can be discovered later. First, document the path of the danger that has been discovered.

What is the reason for the suffering of Harijans since the time of Sree Krishna? The Yadava clan in North India came into being by divine decree. Here, it is the Shudra class from the Nair downwards. Even though the Chola and Pandya dynasties and Marthanda Varma came to power by divine decree, it was of no use to the Harijans. The reason for this is the ignorance of the Hindu elites. The 84 castes within the Shudra class are the result of a tactical intellectual move to serve the interests of the Hindu elites. Due to the grip of caste, they will neither get close to each other, nor will they let others get close. It eventually culminated in the designation 'Na-Iyer'. The Nair community did not understand this tactic. The Hindu religion, or Aryan religion, is essentially a Shudra class fighting among themselves in ignorance. The status of 'Na-Iyer' was given to them to make them fight like this.

The dharma known as Sanatana has not been practiced here. What is called Sanatana has been confined within the framework of the Manusmriti. However, they have also delineated a danger in it. This lineage of Manu first brought about the Surya Vamsa and Chandra Vamsa. Then they wrote down, 'Brahmano mama daivatam'. This was portrayed as the Hindu religion and transformed into temples and their retinues.

The rule of the Devas belongs to the Treta and Dwapara yugas. This mistake can be rectified only when Kali begins. Only then will the dharma called Sanatana be complete. This specific dharma is not practiced anywhere outside India. Let us understand at least one thing, is there anyone else after Rama to speak of a path of karma in that manner? Great effort has been made to turn this Rama into a Vaishnavite to accomplish world-gathering. That is exactly what is happening even today. It was out of ignorance of this path of karma that Mahatmaji was made to speak! That remains a dispute even today. Everyone knows who killed that Mahatmaji. Even today, the karma of Godse is what is happening here. That karma is eager to establish the Hindu religion all over India. As far as Hindus are concerned, they do not know this. The Hindu people believe that this belongs to Sanatana. Look at another trick played to make them believe so: from the day 'Aham Brahmasmi' began to be taught, the misfortune of Sanatana began. Thus, through the four Vedas, functioning through the Chaturvarnya without understanding the times, that misfortune arrived, culminating in a state of karma where the yugadharmas were unknown. Upon reaching that karma, Kali took over the karmic trajectory of destruction and operated.

Kali is not destruction. The four varnas exist at all times. They are present in this Kali too. They are present in other yugas as well. The Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra must understand about the refinement of character. No one doubts the Satya Yuga. But there is no one to act in it. The reason is that the other three periods operated without understanding their purpose. Therefore, Sanskrit is the language that was refined in such a way that no one could go outside the subjugation of the Deva. Sanskrit is the language that is called the language of the Devas, by giving it an interpretation and refining it. The eminent scholars who believe this to be the divine language still do not know that this is the danger of the error that occurred in the Manu lineage. No one knows the secret that 25 chaturyugas have been operating in this manner. It is in this state that the 'four-faced' nature disappeared and the 'three-faced' nature emerged—Brahma, Vishnu, and Maheswara. People say that the fourth head does not exist. A story was cooked up for this as follows: when the meaning of Omkara was asked, it was not known, so the head was pinched off. It is not known to which blind person this matter was asked!
Therefore, in the karmayoga called Bhadra, which came to mitigate Kali, the exploits of Bhadrakali were added and began to be glorified. Thus, it was separated into Shakta and Shaiva.

The people of South India were proclaimed to be monkeys! One of them is Rama's devotee, Hanuman. Thus, the conceptual poem called Ramarajya was fabricated by the excessive flaw of creating the Dravidian sphere, turning them into flawed karmic entities without color or quality. Being thrown into the ignorance of not being able to think whether Ramarajya should take place in this Kali, the gimmick containing the blunder of Ramarajya was the reason for the killing of Mahatmaji. Then, bringing about a karmic flaw to the extent of calling out Omkali, Mahakali, Karikali, and Bhadrakali in that arena, adding a story of Mahisha, taking it to the place of Ramarajya, and implementing it as well. That is how 'Omkali, Mahakali, Bhadrakali, Om' came about. Thus, by adding and pronouncing 'Om' in every way, the glory of the syllable Om was diminished. Shaktas, Shaivas, and the four types of people in South India turned to that path. If the entire population of these four states celebrates in this way, one cannot even imagine what the situation of the people of North India would be. As a result of Vaishnavas, Shaivas, and Shaktas becoming corrupted in that manner, we say here like this:
'A sheep and a cow have two horns
The Iyengar Swami has three horns'

This too is a senseless blunder that we are made to perform. The objective is that this Kali must pass away unnoticed. For that, they began to add the word Rama to everything. That is the refined language. Sanyasis and scholars have paraded and died without knowing this story. No one has ever understood that these are the traditions of the Hindu religion. That is the karmic trajectory that has been brought from Sabdaroopavali to Amarakosha. It was written starting like this: 'Amaranirjjara Deva'. When this was imposed, the calculation of time became unknown. In what is considered time, the Satya Yuga was changed into truth. The Treta Yuga and Dwapara Yuga were turned into the time of the Devas. It was also established that Kali is destruction. Having brought the Shudra class to a state where they do not know that Kali is not destruction, a fence is being built within the Hindu system. This is the flaw in India's theory of Dharma, and of Karma as well. At the same time, it is said in at least some places in the Puranas that 'among the times, Kali is the best'. A word is given to let it be known that there is such a truth, not for the sake of true understanding. Kali is the time to realize what India has been suffering for 25 chaturyugas due to the ignorance of such a dharma. I wish to inform you this much. This is the habituation, arrogance, and ruin of the Hindu religion.

The tragic fate of the Shudra class who unknowingly celebrated the term Nair! The unfortunate Shudra of today is one who thinks he will perish if that is not added. Even the Harijan has not understood till date that what has been happening for 25 chaturyugas is a perilous entanglement. It is good for the government and the Hindu religion, which has derailed the foundation of the Manu lineage, to think about cultivating a sense of karma regarding what can be done about this. Otherwise, the danger that has befallen the Harijans is the inability to think for which era the tantric karma was written down, to create ignorant idols that make one ask about their own daughter, "Is this Bhadrakali?", causing them to be called scoundrels and beggars who act out dramas as eternal sinners and die. This ignorant Shudra is the patrilineal legacy of caste determination tied to the head of the headless Shudra, just to show that they do not belong to that. Therefore, I am telling you one thing: Kali is the same for the Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra. That is the karma told to you in a single word in the Bhagavata: 'Among the times, Kali is indeed the best'.

If we cannot break the cage of blunders fallen into without knowing what Kali dharma is, clear the karmic flaws, acquire the knowledge to think about what this term Nair is for, and reach the Sanatana system, the Kali dharma will end without our knowledge. The paths encompassing karmic purity shown to us as divine today for this purpose are grihashuddhi, devashuddhi, and pithrushuddhi. Complete these three paths and entrust the fourth to the Guru. This is the truth of Sanatana.

Kali is the era that takes over and functions in the position known as Brahmavit, Brahmavaryan, Brahmavarishtan, and Brahmavareeshtan. How this happens is that correcting the mistakes of those three eras starting from the Satya Yuga is the duty of the Guru. When this started being preserved in a Hindu manner, the result of tossing it back and forth turned Sri Krishna into the husband of 16,008 women. What is the scientific justification for this? Or can the ordained duty of the times be accommodated here? What today's writers rush to depict as a miraculous cinematic crisis is an exaggeration of this. For this single reason, if people from any other country hear such things, they would reject the truth, saying they do not wish to walk backward but want to move forward. Many such people come to India and again become worshippers of the idol of miracles. One of the blunders in this is the karmic flaw of not knowing what Kali is. The special rule of this Kali dharma is not about Harijans or the people of Hari; it is the preservation of the Kali era that formulates the principles of time. We should rejoice that this is the era we got to be born in. At least some of us might have thought, "I belong to this marginalized community, don't I?" One should never think like that. Even Narayana Guru has spoken about this with pain. That is the achievement of the artistic trickery that has led people astray to this day. In the same matter, the fact that after Sri Krishna, 2,444 great souls came as Gurus and prophets and suffered in pain is proof of this. All this is a dangerous trap in a way that we cannot completely understand. Can't we at least now change the ignorance of assigning the term Harijan to the great Sri Krishna and keeping the poor as Harijans? Note how the lack of righteousness to speak the truth has led to various wrong paths. It is said that when Rama acted, he happened to see the karma standing above, and saying there was no point in living anymore, he went down into the river. It is written that Ramatirtha attained Jal-samadhi (immersion in water). To this day, no one knows where Sri Shankara's samadhi is. About Ramalinga of Vadalur, it is said like this:
'That supreme devotee of Parameshwara
Who departed without dying with his body'

A miracle brims here. We can see many such instances where ignorance crept in even among the ascetics. Then how will this knowledge reach ordinary people? The righteous system of Kali is not meant to show miracles or to make up things that do not exist. The time-reckoned karma of Kali is to affirm what exists. Did the ignorance of this Yuga dharma come from one of us, or did it come from the common people?

Won't all this catch up with these people who chant the names of Rama and Ravana? Haven't we only been able to stray from the path where Buddha, Jain, and Moses stand? Look at the great Jesus and the Prophet themselves. The Jews are waiting, saying their God will come as an emperor's son. Because of that, they can neither accept Jesus nor give peace to Jesus. A group among them says: 'Sins were washed away by the blood of Jesus.' Isn't that just like the Hindu saying, 'If you kill, the sin is resolved by eating'?

Those who know anything about the words of the Prophet should not speak about certain things added by the Islamic administration. It is better to think whether those words represent the knowledge shown towards the truth. That is today's Shia-Sunni administration or the Shia-Sunni conflict. If the prophets themselves are drowned in this manner, how should we accept all this?

In this manner, making a mockery of everything, composing hypocritical dramas, performing non-existent roles, it is a frenzy of a senseless story made into a Kathakali. To dress up and dance that, and because dressing up wasn't enough, Darikan and Kali also challenged each other to a fight and put an end to it. How much righteous sense do those obsolete writers have who created a flawed Kali out of the word Bhadrakali, who ended it like that? Since saying all this will never end, I am cutting it short.

Today, in this solar system, whatever artistic creations and destructive creations are evolving, a subject is being informed with the desire that its creators and worshippers should know: To share all this in a deserving manner with humans, artists and actors must understand and behave accordingly. Otherwise, to avoid the dangerous trap that may come, to gain the light of knowledge that remains vigilant to evoke God's mercy against the scholarly and ignorant farces that created everything from your vowels and consonants to sound forms, I say in your own language: Without destroying the poor people who yearn for the compassion of life by making them owners of a subconscious mind in the intellectual exercise of sharply judging someone as mad, a madwoman, ignorant, or knowledgeable, without making them madmen and madwomen, with the desire to become parents of children who can impart the karma of distinguishing between good and bad, and to become all kinds of such guardians, to work and see for the light of truth,
How to know the Guru of the ages

It is about the four yugas (Chaturyuga) of time being spoken of. By continuously calculating the four yugas, many have reduced the duration of Kali to 5000. This is a karmic flaw cast in the mold of the intellect. Because, one needs to know about the temporal duty that repeats the part called origin. The glories of the Guru of the ages have the nature of seeing and telling how the origin of the nine planets happened. After creating these nine planets, they have been made fit for travel in a way that their times cannot be determined. When we say fitness for travel, we only see the Earth, the Moon, and the Sun in our line of sight. The remaining planets do not fall in our eyes. But it is not that they do not exist. They do. We do not see how the other planets are. If the dharma of Kali has to be carried out through the discoveries of scientists when this happens, it is to inform you that it will become a cause for destruction.

Instead of science, in that state referred to as the evolutionary trajectory of karma, we observe karma operating right from a single atom. This is the intrinsic essence of the evolutionary trajectory of karma. There has been a tidal wave of discoveries in this century. Through continuous discoveries, it has reached a stage reminiscent of the aforementioned travelers of the Pushpaka Vimana. Today, what has been brought forth in its place is the missile. Scientists must realize this. That kind of science is yet to come. It hasn't arrived. When the destiny of such a discovery unfolds, people will be afraid to even touch it. At that time, the very existence of the earth will reach an intermediate crisis. This is an impending subject. For you to carefully understand this, in our discoveries to date, you are mistakenly interpreting demonic actions as divine actions right here on earth. This is the Bermuda Triangle in the Atlantic. Those who went there could be seen going, but no one was seen returning. No one knows how they go. Only a magnetic field exists. That is another aspect of the tantric karma instituted by creating the aforementioned magnetic field. You yourselves bring out the evidence for all that. When science was written for it, it became a story where Hanuman, to save the ancestors in the puranas and epics, went somewhere, uprooted a mountain, and brought it back. That is 'Marunthuvazhum Malai' or Maruthvamala. The unfurling of mythological stories, which people have not hesitated to tell to this day, extends up to Kathakali or Harikatha. When it became impossible to write and dissect even the story of Hari, Mahatmaji, who is considered to have fought for the nation, was made to create the Harijans. Another remedy for that was killing him off. What spread from there is the mere karmic affliction called democracy, transformed into political pawns. What is astonishing about what was said is the dark clouds of socialism. As it grows, dismantling the layers of freedom one by one, it becomes the caste-determining political curiosity of humans plagued by the karmic affliction of caste-political freedom-seeking. Who is this karmic affliction meant to nurture? Who is it meant to sustain? This is an act of seeing how to capture the position of the President of India once it matures. The political culture in this direction is a dangerous trap brimming with the vile characteristic of installing someone as the President. The caste determination of this Shudra class has turned into the Shudra dharma that stands at 83-84 percent. The dynastic culture is what brought the administrative skills of certain countries by combining caste rule and religious culture, which even distanced God in this caste determination. Thus written down, the wondrous trajectory of karma, suffering from the depletion of dharma, has been mixed with mantra, tantra, and yantra, and thrown into a mud pit. The aforementioned mud pit consists of religious culture, prophetic culture, and the Guru's path in the color of time, written in a way that makes them unrecognizable. Disasters that cannot be retrieved, no matter what falls into that mud pit, will lurk there. That disaster is the bomb.
