All these are among the peculiarities falling under the merit of the government here. Since then, they have been strongly advocating for the nuclear agreement. Is there anything greater than this act of creating a demon in the dark? Who is meant to be saved by the welfare of this savage race that truly does not know whether it is a demon or a god? Is there anything beyond the Vedic uproar called 'Aham Brahmasmi', brought to a four-word statement in a single word of absolute truth? Is there anything on the path ahead greater than the karmic wrath that sustains karma through the miscalculated chronological dharma filled with righteous indignation along this path? If the almanac of the erroneous hand, saying Madan, Nadan, Nadesan over and over again about the phantom city that has risen up to now on this path, is distributed, where will the center of the people be? Socialism is an introduction that summarizes all this. The karmic affliction of not considering whether this will work even in one's own home. What is to be gained from the special aphorisms that are unknowingly nurturing the growth of the epics and mythologies created by the mold of an intellect paralyzed by these caste enthusiasts, rationalism, and liberationism? To fulfill the dharma of Kali by each of us thinking, where has the special dharma of Manusmriti hidden itself, which operated knowing the times to think, know, and bring to fruition for which era this Advaita philosophy is being thrown before the suffering people, to the eminent scholars who bring ruin by preaching duality and non-duality to the public with the special intellect of 'Kali Shudrankal'? Or how was it hidden? You should not think that the karma is complete with such a background description. Is there anything greater than the devotional song singing 'Govinda! Govinda!' everywhere, incorporating it into the Hindu creation without wasting the ever-newly reflecting youth who wish to become the father and mother, the householders leading family lives? Is there anything greater than this universal sound of the name, formed by growing in the tradition of chanting names completed by speaking of Shaktheyam, Shaivam, and Vaishnavam in this manner, teaching the colors, and combining the sound and musical notes of music? Think! The Somnath temple we mentioned earlier is one of those built and suppressed with the special powers and sleight of hand that came according to the Hindu dharma or yoga rules, having completely acquired the special merits of this fourth quarter obtained to be born in this Kali Yuga dharma given by God, where the Kali Yuga dharma cannot be implemented using paths of psychic powers or yoga. All of you know what its final state was. If it is further processed with medicine, mantra, and tantra, can the dharma of time be determined? Or rather, this dance of psychic powers is the completion of the tidal wave through the distinction between the scholar and the layman. Evaluating whether this is suitable for this Kali Yuga and thinking about it, the special rule of the fourth quarter of Kali is what completes the dharma of 'Mata Pita Guru'. If this is characterized by revealing logic, liberation, some administrative strategy, and deceit, it is nothing but the plight of one who tries to separate the waves of the sea from the water. Think! Let each of you become an individual for your own good or for the awakening of the world. May Kali Dharma bless you!

How can one know the Guru of the ages? That is vision (Darshan). If the medium of vision becomes a medium ignorant of the times, these mistakes will occur. That is why you were told that if the medium of vision begins with scientific distortion, it will become a destructive act of leaping into unrighteous action, much like the monkey-play of the Hindu religion. It ceases to be destruction only in the path of the Guru who understands the Dharma of the times (Kaladharma). That means a separate space (sky/akasha) for each of these nine spheres mentioned. There is a cosmic direction encompassing all these nine. The cyclical nature of the nine planets (Navagrahas) serves to keep all nine in their respective places, regulating light, heat, and cold. What else can you impart here other than the lack of culture built upon the emotional market of the liquor lobby, completed by men and women, serving the foolishness of the intellectuals who live denying the Yugadharmas, having pushed that discovery up to the level of the Devas? But that is not what is being said. From the moment the times reaching the atomic science of vision are quantified and shown, the calculations of the Navagrahas, calculated from a single fraction of Indian mathematics, are counted completely starting from the atom. This is vision. That vision is the calculation of totality, created through the five elements, experienced through the five senses, and counted and shared as life and soul. It has grown and evolved into eggs and worms, from ant eggs or even aquatic insects. The path of merit called Dharma is the duty-bound theoretical principle regarding the juncture of birth and death, which described atomic sciences in that manner. The one upon whom such fortune has dawned is bestowed with the Dharma of the Guru. That is not a sage standing under the city of Vetala, the Deva, and the Devaloka. Instead, it is the Guru standing above the Devas.
It will take ages for the karma, which has been set apart as Deva, Devi, and Rishi, to arrive.

Having said all this, there is an account here that enumerates ten Upanishads—Narayana Upanishad, Brihadaranyaka, Mandukya, Chandogya, and so on—starting in a stream of light. But today, we see thousands of Upanishadic hymns. When other Upanishads encroached upon the path of karma that entered the intellect from the path of vision, the scholarly specialized cessation and translation were formed by leaking the essence that resonates as 'Om'. Then, returning to the path whence it came, the righteous indignation that poured the humor of Hindu hymns and even reached the cinema occurred. Cultivating this, completing the spectacle of miracles, attaining mastery in medicine, mantras, and sleight of hand, the song about the four yoga theories formulated by the saints has been completed. If new concepts are turned into the nine poisons (Navapashanas) and utilized in that knowledge, how can that be contained within this theory of evolution? As long as the knowledge called scientific theory violates the Yugadharma by intruding into the true theory of the vision of the Chaturyuga, which is called the chronology of birth, death, and disease, it will never be possible to understand what the necessity of Kali is. This Dharma of Kali is the translational capacity of the matter when reaching the cause, both macroscopically and microscopically, not just of today's children of men, but of all living beings. In biological evolution, the chronological determination of each Yuga and Manu has come through that path. A Manvantara is noted for a period of 71 Chaturyugas. When this proceeds scientifically, there will arise a predicament where the atomic radiation produced in the crucible of experimentation and observation cannot be suddenly controlled. In this death race called governance, where all countries rush, hiding within the framework sketched over ages by the truth called Dharma, attaining the fulfillment of life that touches the heart with the love called God, if one writes with science, will this fulfillment of life come? Ponder this.

The part that discerns the secret of evolution is the source of the Guru-disciple relationship. It is fulfilled through four epochs. The four epochs are—Satyayuga, Tretayuga, Dwaparayuga, and Kaliyuga. When repeatedly noted in that manner, the time of a solar system will have to be determined. The vision along that path is the true vision. A Manvantara is defined by one solar system, and a deluge (Pralaya) is mentioned after 14 such Manvantaras. Only the assemblies of sages above the Trimurti can state this calculation. The Sanskritization by scholars who wrote concisely to state this calculation stands attaining blessings and curses amidst the tumult of the lineage of Devas. Knowing today the matters where Manu Dharma could not be understood and the return to the Manu lineage became impossible due to the aforementioned mistake, we are presenting to the light of the world an action that corrects that mistake. In accordance with this, there must be rulers who execute the welfare of the world through the knowledge of this Guru lineage for respective eras. It is for this that we have begun the Gurukula Brahmanivedita Karma today. The reason it is called Gurukula Brahmanivedita is that the coming generations of men and women involved in this should be able to recognize what Kaladharma is and determine and state the times. The beginning of such a generation is what we mark today through the differentiated states called vision. Otherwise, it will not happen even if we just do it. It is an open secret known to us all that Rabindranath Tagore, in the guise of a sage, sitting under a tree and on a banyan platform, studied and sought scholarly secrets. It is such scholarly secrets, which have crossed many similar eras, that we are studying today. Even so, where can we reach? As if recreating this, learning what the journey of the primal Manvantara was, we are imparting to the public a traditional theory concerning the era when six Manvantaras and three Chaturyugas were completed. One must recognize what constitutes the body made of the five elements, which comprises right and wrong. We know that this reaches the winged termite from the termite, and they all seek the light. The fulfillment of the Manvantara divided into four epochs is the guidance for each time period reaching up to the human race. Thus, after six Manvantaras and three Chaturyugas passed, it could not be completed due to the mistake of a Guru of the ages who came in the Manu lineage.

We have started today to correct and rewrite the changes that occurred in each Yuga of every Chaturyuga. To bring about the chronological calculation according to the divine decree (Brahmanishchaya), the previously mentioned evolutionary stages must be crossed. There are records somewhere stating that 360 human years equal one year of the Devas. We need not bother searching for that. In the path of vision we have received today, Gurus who can reveal at least the secret of one Chaturyuga must be born. It is this Guru who can be definitively called the Guru of the ages.

The calculations available to us today have been continuously studied, recited, and taught by the ignorant Shudra class, following the trail of class hatred manifested in the concepts of the Solar (Suryavamsha) and Lunar (Chandravamsha) dynasties, which were transcribed by Brahmins devoid of divine sanction and spiritual experience. The anachronistic theories intertwined with the Solar and Lunar dynasties constitute a fatal snare, having suffered the distortions of the cycle of birth, death, and virtue within this tradition, which was shaped by the narratives, teachings, and machinations of curious minds. This forms part of the abbreviated script characterized as a secretive tribute shrouded in the guise of both the scholarly and the ignorant. What is it that we require? We must be capable of tracing the reverential rituals and chronological accounts of the *Yamas* practiced across the four epochs (*Yugas*) back to at least one *Manvantara* or one *Chaturyuga*. The evolutionary theory guiding this path constitutes the true philosophical vision (*Darshana*). Through this evolutionary framework, it is the four epochs, governed by the Guru of the Ages (*Kalantaraguru*), that must illuminate where deviations occurred and where they did not. The evolution that unfolded during the Satya Yuga, Treta Yuga, and Dvapara Yuga encompasses the profound secret of life, extending from an ant's egg, termed the primordial unit (*Andaka*), up to a lizard's egg. The vision encapsulates the mystery of biological evolution, signifying the vast indivisibility of life thriving across both aquatic and terrestrial realms. The custodian of such profound secrets is the *Kalantaraguru*. This secret represents a pathway designed to fulfill the epochal duty (*Yugadharma*) within the Guru-disciple lineage destined for ultimate self-realization (*Brahmasakshatkara*). It embodies the esoteric knowledge of the mystery known as Manu, of Sage Manu, or the sage recognized as the *Kalantaraguru*. This is the Guru who has emerged into the illuminating awareness of the widely publicized epochs of the Manu lineage!

To comprehensively articulate the ordained duties (*Dharma*) of each epoch, five Gurus appear in every *Yuga* in accordance with the *Yugadharma*. It is the philosophical proponents, who fail to preserve intellectual rigor and mental dignity in such esoteric visions, who have polished and transcribed the verses through scholarly rationale in a manner that renders the measurement of epochs impossible. Along this trajectory, individuals ignorant of the fundamental steps of reverence have progressed through the creation of the fourfold caste system (*Chaturvarnya*) up to the performance of twilight prayers (*Sandhyavandana*). What we witness today is an ideological outrage born of karmic flaws, oblivious to the macrocosmic, microcosmic, causal, or effectual realities. Consequently, we remain ignorant of what constitutes truly venerable action. The esoteric work *Darshanamala* elucidates this to us in a novel manner. It reveals that the path of action dedicated to the Supreme (*Brahmaniveditakarmamarga*) is the Guru's path to comprehending the philosophical construct ordained for each respective *Yuga*. When the path of Dharma along this route reaches a theoretical culmination, it unveils the unique philosophical vision declaring the arrival of the cyclical repetition of all four epochs.
How did the precise determination of the Kali Yuga become impossible?

Long before the advent of Hinduism, the Earth had already undergone the transition of twenty-five *Chaturyugas*. One might ask whether *Chaturyugas* existed prior to these twenty-five *Chaturyugas*. They indeed did. That was the *Chaturyuga* system observed in the Manu tradition. It is divinely ordained.

An inadvertent error has precipitated prolonged calamities. This devastation escalated and ultimately destroyed the cyclical resilience inherent in the concepts of 'Bharatiya', 'Hindu', and 'Sanatana'. These adversities were dormant only during the first three *Chaturyugas* of the current *Manvantara* (Vaivasvata Manvantara). To rectify this error, a new mandate emerged in the fourth *Chaturyuga*. That is, the corrective action commenced from the seventh *Chaturyuga*. By the eleventh *Chaturyuga* of this *Manvantara*, the Trinity system (*Trimurti Sampradaya*) was completely formalized.

The lineage of Manu was flawless. Until today, numerous attempts have been made in various guises to rectify the inadvertent error. It did not succeed. Furthermore, it paved the way for numerous imaginative speculations. With the influx of these speculative fantasies, the functional capacity required for accurate chronological determination was lost. The Trinity system (*Trimurti Sampradaya*) was meticulously managed through the tenth *Chaturyuga* of this *Manvantara*—utilizing yoga, law, and the calculation of the six foundational chakras (*Adharas*). Yet, the lost capacity for action could not be reclaimed.

Of the nine realms (*Navamandalas*) described, seven possess form. The remaining two exist in a manner capable of centralizing form. It constitutes a cyclical phenomenon entangled with Rahu, Ketu, and Saturn. When the prescribed duties associated with the seven heavens representing the seven realms were established, the Satya Yuga progressed truthfully. However, the majesty of nature, which shared dominion over the remaining three epochs, altered its temporal course. This deviation gave rise to the ideological propagation characterizing Kali Yuga as a period of absolute destruction. This propagating argument continues to persist even today. That is well-known to everyone. The multitude of speculative narratives already constructed through the refined language (Sanskrit) is innumerable. A perilous trap, wherein the capacity for action could not align with Dharma across various instances, paved the way for the very destruction of time. Consequently, Kali became categorized as an epochal duty defined by destruction.

We cannot progress by denying what actually exists. The operational capacity we have internalized thus far is the cumulative anomaly of the twenty-one *Chaturyugas* that have transpired. It has become so entangled that no one can grasp it anywhere. Consequently, both the learned and the unlearned have drowned alike, losing all chronological accuracy. Crores of great souls who emerged to operate for brief periods have sunk in the uncertainty of this epoch. As Hinduism was formalized in this manner, the *Sanatana* essence was lost. As a result of concluding without knowing where to begin, an ignorance arose in the writings praising the six-faced god (Kartikeya)—claiming that when asked the meaning of *Omkara*, the face of wisdom was pinched off due to ignorance. Thus, not only was true knowledge eradicated, but the refined cultures were academically inscribed and formalized from the *Amarakosha* to the *Sreeramodantam*. The very inception of the *Amarakosha* reflects this. Therefore, it was only possible to record for this *Chaturyuga* a naturally occurring state of transition that had been documented over ten *Chaturyugas*. This very state of transition also manifested at the beginning of this Kali Yuga. Hence, the delusion of 'Kali-destruction' took hold. Consequently, the ornamental phonetic expressions, repetitively established until now, culminated in the formalization of the deity. That epochal duty slipped away in Kali without conveying anything. On a path traversed in such a manner, Kali reached a position bereft of Dharma; Kali became synonymous with destruction.

We must specifically comprehend the Dharma of Kali. However, the evaluation of a transitional state—which lost its entire functional capacity due to the perpetual categorization of Kali as an era of absolute destruction, staggering in an arena devoid of Dharma—is what annihilated the Dharma of Kali. As a result, the Kali Yuga, which had been functioning well, was also obliterated. To elaborate, when the operational capacity from Kali up to the Treta Yuga functioned devoid of the Satya Yuga, it drowned in a procession of Puranas and epics exclusively glorifying the deity or the Supreme Goddess (*Parashakti*). The stellar alignments (*Nakshatrapankti*) delineate the trajectories of the great souls who arrived to protect Dharma during such epochs. Incapable of deciphering its true essence, our ancestors even attempted to formalize it as the 'constellation system' (*Nakshatravyuham*). Claiming to have directly consulted God for this, they have inscribed certain things, leaving it impossible to determine whether they are real or fictional. Even a peculiar narrative, stating, "I will not let your devotees go to see you," has been appended within the Puranas.

Having finalized numerous Deva-Asura systems, they also attempted to conclude a narrative bestowing the intellect of ten heads upon Ravana. Is this not a colossal failure in itself? Furthermore, when the term 'Avatar' had to be applied to the architects of the twenty-seven *Nakshatras*, the twelve zodiac signs (*Rashis*), and the nine planetary positions (*Grahanilas*), they were forced to proceed in an overtly scholarly manner. Consequently, the Dharma of true vision (*Satyadarshana*) ceased to exist. Moreover, billions of stellar constellations remain merely as remnants. If it is stated that this is our worldly trajectory of Karma, how will anyone understand it? Where will the propagation of Dharma, which had been operating in accordance with the *Yugadharma*, ultimately reach? In short, this is the ideological flaw in declaring the era as 'Kali-destruction'.

Due to the lack of precise chronology regarding the creative endeavors of various great men across different epochs, fluctuations occurred at the junctures of these eras. This has significantly impacted Indian culture, as it was in Bharata that actions were historically aligned with the *dharma* of the epochs. In truth, this is the true religion known as *Sanatana*. This constitutes Indian culture and the heritage of Bharata. This definitive *dharma* ought to have been transmitted through the *Manusmriti*. However, the *Manusmriti* remains confined within the conceptual boundaries of the Trimurti, Devendra, and Parashakti.

How did the assertion of "Kali's destruction" originate? It stemmed from the misfortune of having to chronicle the epochs that rained destruction since the time of Sree Krishna using twenty-seven constellations, and the tragic necessity of concocting Puranic narratives through an easy method by portraying the story of Hari as a mere playful tale. Such inappropriately patched shortcuts are the reason the *yugadharma* (dharma of the epoch) of Kali ceased to exist. These condensed versions were incorporated into the Puranas, Shastras, and Vedas intended for the Kali era. Since they were meant to aid in philosophical realization, corresponding Vedantic hymns were also appended. Operating in a timeless void and proclaiming time in a manner that obscures the profound dynamics of life—this constitutes the altered state designated as Kali. Consequently, the authentic truth is no longer available from the hands of the wise. Today, all we possess is a mere procession of Puranic epics concocted across different periods. The narratives formulated in this manner have ultimately been stripped of their chronological accuracy.
Gurukula Brahmaniveditham
Know What the Truth Is
(When the biography of the Guru, titled "Through the Karmic Realm of Sacrifice" prepared by the lineage of disciples, was read aloud, for its completion,
the words spoken by the Guru)

What we have observed thus far is a prevailing resolve to instantly destroy the life of a great soul the moment they are born, regardless of whether the household is worthy or not. Therefore, this birth is kept concealed as the Brahman itself. Doctrinal theories insist that a great soul must be born as an emperor of emperors. However, when questioned about the logical justification of such a doctrine, we mostly encounter a karmic inadequacy that leaves one speechless.

Numerous great souls have emerged since Sree Krishna. All of them arrived with the advent of another doctrine. In short, Vyasa, numerous prophets born as world teachers, and the similarly originated *Parayi Petta Panthirukulam* (the twelve tribes born to the Pariah woman) have defined this emergence. When studying the theological doctrines constructed by the Hindu *dharma* to confine everything within the divine tradition, one perceives an illusion as if a method of deception was bestowed by God Himself. What kind of an event was the very birth of Krishna?

Before the birth of Krishna, the seven children born to that mother were beaten to death. The eighth one could not be caught, and therefore, was not killed. The story-weavers claim that even though Putana was sent for this purpose, she was destroyed. Looked at from this perspective, whether born as a supreme emperor or in a cow shed, whether born in a hut or a palace without distinction, the karmic saga endured by these great souls has been sung by poets in rhetorical embellishments, disconnected entirely from their actual lives.

If one examines the great souls who arrived after Sree Krishna, it is evident that their very lives have been toyed with. The profound ignorance of the scholar who presents this as a unique narrative is not insignificant. When viewed through the lens of the epochal *dharma*, their lives have been so excessively eulogized that the truth is obscured, making it impossible to establish historical chronology. This becomes clear upon examining the long list of poetic imaginations adorned with both praise and condemnation. The foremost example of this is the life of Sree Krishna himself.

Concealing the evidence that Sree Krishna arrived as a Guru, millions of stories have been woven portraying him as a deity. By transforming Krishna into a god and preserving the Gopis as *devadasis* (servants of god) in a manner that eradicates his identity as a Guru, reality has been obfuscated through the acquired, *dharma*-less tales born from the rhetorical flair of eminent poets, thereby displacing *dharma* and squandering *karma*. In order to fabricate the narrative that Vyasa lived contemporaneously with Krishna, Vyasa was specially bestowed with the appellation 'Krishna Dwaipayana'.

Dwaraka submerged. When Arjuna, following Krishna's instructions, gathered everyone and departed from there, forest bandits looted everything from him. It is recorded that they slaughtered many and spared Arjuna. At that juncture, Vyasa is reported to have said: you were able to utilize the boons of the gods, along with the bow and arrows obtained from them, only while the Lord was present. Now, let us proceed to embrace asceticism. It is a known fact to all that these events are said to have occurred in the region where Gujarat is currently situated.

Observing from then until now, the births of all great souls following Krishna's era resemble hidden arrows. Because Buddha was born into a royal lineage, he remained silent without doing anything initially. Eventually, when he became a Bodhisattva, he was killed by being fed pork. Similarly, it is said that Jyothiramalinga departed in his physical body, leaving only a lamp behind. Those who wrote the story of Rama many epochs ago state that he abandoned his physical body in the river, while poetic imagination suggests he was taken away in a chariot to some unknown realm. The story of attaining *Jalasamadhi* (merging with water) is also told regarding Ramatirtha.

Thus, whoever became a Shudra by birth and a Dvija (twice-born) by action, all of them have been destroyed in this manner, even reducing them to mere poets. What exactly is the history of Kabirdas? Even though it was conveniently written that he was a disciple of Swami Ramadas, no one knows what purpose that suffering served. Here too, they have been defeated by fabricated narratives. What was Kabir's devotion to his Guru? "Even if all the trees that have grown strong to date and those yet to come in the world were made into pens, and all the oceans into ink, writing with them would still leave the Guru's greatness inexhaustible"—this was Kabir's devotion to his Guru.

When examining the historical presence of great souls, the exceedingly rare stories written about them have subjected them to the karmic flaw of miracles, completely destroying all their experiential truths in an ocean without water (making them incomprehensible). We must carefully discern the underlying motive behind writing and preserving the stories of Moses, Buddha, Jesus, and the Prophet, who came after Krishna. It is these fabricated miraculous deeds that the poor intellectuals have been manipulated to propagate. When speaking of realization or philosophical vision, apart from being recorded as the light of the world, the embodiment of light, or an abundance of sermons, there too, it is the gods who have been glorified.

The truth regarding the births of Moses and Jesus has been veiled in a way that renders it unrecognizable. Even the portion assigning the karmic purpose to recount Jesus's sacrifice has been distorted. If there is evidence for the claims that the Prophet who came after Jesus was chased away by the people, that the mountain was set on fire, that upon the fire extinguishing he descended and ate roasted leather, and that he proclaimed 'Alas, it is the Jinn who rule the world'—then why has the exact location of that great man's resting place (Samadhi) not been fully revealed? In reality, upon witnessing the demonic power of these Jinn, he simply sat down in that very graveyard. Once seated in one place, natural bodily excretions would be evident for seven or eight days. Eventually, his existence concluded there. In spite of all this, where was that profound sorrow taken and appeased? Without even establishing that historical truth to serve as a reminder, today they attempt to express devotion in a language far more severe than the Hindus. Having ostensibly bestowed sanctity upon that great man's life through such a path of devotion, the realms of sacrifice have been preserved as lands of miracles, in a manner that makes it impossible for us to comprehend or collectively preserve them.
What will become of our children who inherit such karmic flaws?

From Lord Krishna to the present day, no one has been spared. After the time of the great souls, who can resolve the karmic affliction that preserves them merely as miraculous phenomena? Is this not the wicked obsession of demonic forces that refuse to embrace the karma of this land of sacrifice?

The miraculously decisive dharma, which demonstrates the boundless excellence of yoga and karma by categorizing them into Yoga, Bhakti, Karma, and Jnana, has been attempted to be depicted through Lord Krishna and Swami Vivekananda. What can be done about the so-called champions of dharma who cause intellectual decay by engaging in arguments in the names of Sri Shankara, Chattampi Swami, and Narayana Guru, who were born in Kerala? They have reduced the people to mere puppets and thrust them under a veil of blindness. Hatred based on caste, religion, and class has grown within them to such an extent that even God's forgiveness would be inadequate.

The blue sky is a colorless color that transcends the seven realms known as the realms of knowledge (Jnanabhumika) or ignorance. Today's path of action has been reached through the advancement of science, which has documented the theoretical trajectories of the nine planets in a language accessible to both scholars and laymen. Science has become fragmented, reaching a stage where it can neither be fully quantified nor defined. Modern aeronautical science is in this state. Scientists must contemplate whether we truly need these discoveries, given such names, which possess the potential to destroy the entire earth like the acts of lunatics. What is achieved by measuring the size and weight of every planet? What branch of wisdom is going to emanate from that? What else can be derived from it, other than the path of action that turns a goat into a dog, as the ancients used to say? Having traveled in a manner that never attains true consciousness in life, wearing absurd disguises, abandoning the language of true scholarly eminence, and fostering a culture dressed in ambiguous forms that serves up intellect-killing actions—what can be said to these utter fools? We have nothing to do with such baseless tales that cultivate this kind of absurd humor. We also know that this is a failure of our daily lives. Do we not need at least one good vision...?

Will a realm of action (karmabhumika) emerge if the karma to be realized through life is lost by merely singing, speaking, and writing about it excessively? Is there anything else to this beyond an intellect that obeys or forces obedience through rules? Are all these spectacles we see merely stages for the play of good and evil, where the words of God are intellectualized? Who does not know that this nurtures and corrupts the multitudes of people who do not know how to behave, realizing that all this is a consequence of the errors of the Yugadharma (the dharma of the age)?

Who does not know that only what the courts construct by swearing in the name of God will prevail? What has the legacy of those ignorant creators made of us—these wretched human figures they have created, who behave like war-mongering beasts, trying to choose good and evil through figures like brigadiers? It is by making us believe that this is global governance that dharma is being presented to us. I ask you again, what else is there in the world other than each person bearing the burden of sins, born from the errors of the Yugadharma, according to their own capacity and strength? Understand this dynamically and reflect!
Guruvani
